system.description:
• Trained to serve a noble house, embassy, or merchant prince rather than a guild or tower — equal parts spellcaster and diplomat, expected to be useful in a council chamber as much as a crisis.
  • Practised at Court: Advantage on checks involving etiquette, protocol, or reading the political temperature of a room.
  • Warded Table: Once per day, as a 1-minute ritual, ward a meal, drink, or small area against poison and scrying for 8 hours — anyone partaking is immediately alerted (not harmed) if either is attempted. Once per encounter, as your reaction when an ally within 30ft is hit, grant them +2 AC against that attack, which may turn it into a miss.
